description: The Supreme Court of the Sri Lanka - Amended the Supreme Courts Rules
reasoning: This gazette content contains rules made by the Supreme Court under Article 136 of the Constitution, specifically amending and rescinding previous rules regarding the attire of Judges and Attorneys-at-Law. This constitutes legal/regulatory matters involving statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation, falling under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes). While it mentions judicial officials by name, it does not involve government personnel changes or portfolio assignments, and the primary focus is on legal rule-making rather than government structure or personnel.
